label: Applying to a Spanish public university for autumn 2027: UNEDasiss, then the region's preinscripción

milestones.label: UNEDasiss accreditation requests open
milestones.note: UNED states the window as an annual rule, 4 February to 1 December. Ignore the December end: the accreditation is needed for the early-July admission deadline, and processing takes about three weeks plus postage.

milestones.label: Preinscripción closes at the public universities
milestones.note: For 2026/27 UNED gave 7 July 2026 as the deadline for international students, with documents allowed until 31 July. Each region and university runs its own preinscripción and some close earlier: Catalonia has one for all its public universities; ask your university for its date.

supplementarySteps: Apply for UNEDasiss accreditation, choosing 'Programa del Diploma IB'. It turns your IB into a Spanish grade out of 10.
To reach 14 points for competitive degrees, sit PCE subject tests. The May call falls during IB exams.
Apply to the preinscripción even if the accreditation has not yet arrived.

notes: Channel 'other' because there is no single portal: UNEDasiss issues the grade, and the application goes to a regional or university preinscripción.
The PCE dates for 2027 are not published; the 2026 precedent is in the country profile's deadlines.
